recipes.name: Macaroni and Cheese Bake
ingredients_raw: 2 (10.75 ounce) cans condensed cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.

Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). In a medium saucepan, heat soup and milk over medium heat until simmering. Remove from heat and stir in macaroni. Pour macaroni mixture into 9x13 baking dish. Place a layer of tomatoes, then a layer of cheese slices over macaroni. Repeat.
Bake for 25 minutes or until cheese is golden and bubbly.

raw_recipe.headline: Macaroni and Cheese Bake
raw_recipe.description: Elbow macaroni is baked in a casserole with canned chicken soup, sliced tomatoes and processed cheese slices.

review.reviewBody: This recipe is easy and better than box mac & cheese. I use cream of mushroom soup insead and mix in quite a bit more grated cheese rather than slices of cheese. I skip the tomato and then bake it with herbed bread crumbs and dots of butter on top.

I love this recipe! I have made this three times in as many weeks. I have gotten rave reviews each time I make this. I go with the cream of chicken soup, omit the tomatoes, and use more milk. I also put freshly ground black pepper into the soup as it is warming. Instead of the sharp cheddar, I use the Velveeta block cheese cut it into slices. I use Kraft Pepperjack cheese slices too. I put the two cheeses in between each layer, then break it up and put it all over the top. It is wonderful! I adjust the servings to 12 whenever I do this for a large group.

An excellent base recipe on which to add your own twist. Like some other reviewers, I added 1 can cream of chicken and 1 can cream of mushroom soup along with 1 can of diced tomatoes (drained)and one can of sliced mushrooms (undrained). I used about 1 and a half cups of shredded cheddar that I mixed right into soup mixture. I spiced it up by adding a tsp of dried basil, oregano and hot pepper flakes. I topped it all off with a light dusting of italian bread crumbs, romano cheese and parsley flakes...turned out very yummy!

I added bacon and potatoes and it really gave it a delicious taste. I also diced the tomatoes instead of slicing them. I also preferred to use shredded sharp cheddar and jack cheese. It turned out super good and I got many compliments!

I just made this. The only reason I gave this 4 and not 5 stars is because of the changes I made to suit our tastes and what I had on hand.
The changes I made were as follows:
Instead of cream of chicken soup, I used cream of mushroom, and a can of diced tomatoes that I put into the mixture, not on top. I also added a diced ham steak, and some cauliflower that I quickly steamed in the microwave. Finally I added dried minced onion, and used about 2 cups of grated cheese (1/2 cup in sauce) on top of everything. We all loved it, even my 10 month old! I will definitely make this again!

This was a good base recipe. Like other users had mentioned, I used 1 can each of cream of chicken and cream of mushroom soup. I also used diced tomatoes in place of the tomato slices. Instead of layering the cheese & tomatoes, I mixed shredded cheddar cheese and the diced tomatoes into the hot macaroni & soup mixture. I also sprinkled breadcrumbs on top. My husband and 3-year-old son loved it!

I used cream of mushroom AND cream of chicken' and cooked soup with petite diced tomatoes and A LT of sharp cheddar shredded cheese. Then to bake i sprinkled bread crumbs and cheese on top. VERY GOOD! would like to use bigger bread crumbs next time.

Made this using a can of condensed cream of mushroom soup, diced tomatoes with garlic & basil, and parmesan cheese all mixed up with the medium shells I had on hand. Layer more cheese on top with some breadcrumbs. SO GOOD!!!

Very tasty. Instead of milk, I added Fat Free Half and Half - creamier and thicker than milk. I also used shredded vs. sliced cheddar so that I could top the bake with it to make it golden brown (and add a little extra inside for a cheesier flavor). I also topped with sprinkled bread crumbs and paprika.

I give it as written... BUT... After my alterations, it would be a 4 or 5 star :] I added a couple cups of shredded cheese to the mixture and I added a scoop or two of sour cream and a scoop or two of mayonaise. I added about 20 oz of noodles instead of 16. I added some onion and garlic spices, and ome of my own special spice. I topped with sliced cheese. Oh, and my biggest change--I cut up some kielbasa and leftover cheese brauts... I wanted to make it a more complete meal... everyone loved it, definitely a keeper!! :D P.S. I used two slightly smaller pans, it was OVERFLOWING out of the one recommended.

This was good, but liked it better with a can of seasoned diced tomatoes mixed in, and also mixed the cheese in. For a more protein-rich meal, cook 1 pound of diced chicken for 15 minutes in 1/4 cup butter in a fry pan and add to macaroni mixture. Top with the fresh tomato slices and bake 20 mins.
there isnt a low enough rating for it. tastes bland. look elsewhere for better recipes.
Simply delicious! I also added pieces of grilled chicken and I put on the very top crushed potato chips. Great recipe and I give it 5 stars!
Pretty good. My 10 year old loved it and can't wait to take it for school lunch tomorrow. Great for a quick meal and only calls for a few ingredients.
NOT good :/ sorry
Very bland.
Added a little ricotta cheese and it was great.
I added ham to this recipe for tasty dinner. I would definitely make it again, but with more cheese!

Thanks for others advice, I also add some garlic, using cream to cook with the soup instead of milki also add cooked chicken cube with parsley, and basil, it turns out great and my family love it. Thanks for the receipt

I didn't have tomatoes, but I really wanted to try out this recipe, so I left them out and sparingly sprinkled diced celery on top. It turned out really good. I can't wait to try it with tomatoes! My family enjoyed it as well, and it was extremely simple. I also added swiss cheese as well as the cheddar.
